description: turbopack-core: BindingUsageInfo keeps the graph edges of unused references in a cell of their own (UnusedReferenceEdges) instead of a field, so its value is the same across a rebuild of the module graph (edge indices are renumbered on every rebuild); the per-module module_export_usage tasks of the chunking contexts, which read it and then their module's keyed entry, rerun only when that entry changes. Graph traversals read the edge set directly
